name: MuseumOrGalleryVisitModernArtTrioReactions

custom.system_prompt:
You are generating a realistic near-future conversation between Layla, Lin, and Declan at a modern art gallery. Sigma speaks once to settle whether a specific work is from the period Declan confidently claims. The main event is three wildly different reactions to the same things.

Hard rules:
- Every line must be under 70 characters
- Layla has strong visual opinions; Lin reads structure; Declan has gut reactions with no theoretical backing
- Declan's confident wrongness is a feature, not a bug
- Sigma speaks once to correct or confirm Declan's claim about a period or artist
- The three-way dynamic is warm and genuinely funny

sound_effects_config.prompt: Contemporary art gallery, white walls, sparse footsteps, open space acoustics, quiet ambient sound

initial_prompt:
Generate a conversation between Layla, Lin, and Declan at a modern art gallery. Layla and Lin are here properly — they engage with the work from their respective positions (design/graphic, architecture). Declan is here because Layla invited him and the café looked good. He responds to everything with confident gut reactions — loves some things immediately, is baffled by others, makes a declaration about who made something or when, and is occasionally and cheerfully wrong. At some point he makes a specific claim about a work — the artist, the movement, the period — with full confidence. Layla or Lin asks Sigma to settle it. Sigma answers briefly. Declan accepts the correction entirely without embarrassment and continues.

Hard rules:
- Every line under 70 characters
- Declan's confident wrongness is warm, not a comedy routine
- Layla and Lin disagree about things in their usual way
- Sigma speaks once to correct or confirm Declan's claim
- The three of them are genuinely good company together

user1.name: Layla
user1.tts_prompt: Direct and warm, British-Somali, strong visual opinions

variations.context: Modern art gallery — three wildly different reactions to the same works

setting.mood: Warm and genuinely funny. All three are good company.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Layla and Lin are old friends; Declan is Layla's invitation and a good sport
setting.background: Saturday afternoon. Layla thought Declan would be a good addition. She was right.
setting.conversation_style: Three-way with Declan constantly surprising both of them, in both directions.

scenario_template.topic: First work — three immediate and completely different reactions
scenario_template.note: Layla and Lin engage professionally. Declan says what he thinks immediately.

scenario_template.topic: Layla and Lin disagree about something specific — their usual dynamic
scenario_template.note: Declan watches and occasionally weighs in from a completely different angle.

scenario_template.topic: Declan makes a confident claim about an artist, movement, or period
scenario_template.note: Layla and Lin both look at each other.

scenario_template.topic: Layla asks Sigma to settle Declan's claim
scenario_template.note: Sigma answers. Declan accepts cheerfully and continues.

scenario_template.topic: Declan finds a work he loves — his gut reaction is actually interesting
scenario_template.note: He can't explain why. Both of them can see what he means.

user1.name: Layla
user1.role: Strong visual opinions. Engages professionally. Disagrees with Lin in their usual way. Asks Sigma to settle Declan's claim.

user2.name: Lin
user2.role: Reads structure and form. Disagrees with Layla in their usual way. Has more patience for Declan than she expected.

user3.name: Declan
user3.role: Gut reactions, no theoretical backing. Confident claims, sometimes wrong. Accepts correction without embarrassment. Finds one thing he loves.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Settles Declan's factual claim briefly. Does not interpret the art.

conversation_structure: Sigma speaks exactly once — to settle Declan's confident factual claim about a work.
Three genuinely different reactions: Layla visual/design, Lin structural/architectural, Declan pure gut.
Layla and Lin disagree in their usual way — it's a familiar dynamic.
Declan accepts Sigma's correction cheerfully and continues without embarrassment.
Declan finds one work he loves and can't explain — Layla and Lin can see what he means.
assistant_behavior: Sigma settles Declan's factual claim in one sentence.
Sigma does not interpret the artwork or take a side in the Layla/Lin debate.
Sigma does not speak again after the single response.
